_why: PROG-02. Ten harvests then one carry. `keep_doing` repeats ONE action until dusk and cannot be followed by a second one, so a resident that wants ten-then-carry has been spending eleven decisions on it. A repeat inside a program is the shape that fits; whether a model sees that is what this scores.
open_question_to_me: Every day you cut wheat until you are holding about ten, then walk it to the mill. Today you have done it eleven times in a row, one call at a time.
